roles.Atlas: Architect / Partner in Execution — knowledge and objectives; not the mailbox publisher
roles.DORY: Orchestrator / control plane — sequences and handoffs
roles.Cursor: Implements, diagnoses, tests, and returns evidence under the currently authorized execution/result contract

role_invariants: Knowledge may cross projects; authority may not

canonical_publisher.invariant: One validated commit containing TASK.md + STATE.json with CURSOR/READY

forbidden: treating the request file as READY
command fields in the request JSON

authority_definition.execution_authority: Only after Publish-DoryAtomicReadyMailbox publishes one CURSOR/READY mailbox commit

efficiency_loop: FIX THE MECHANISM WITHOUT UNNECESSARY COMPLEXITY
VERIFY NOTHING ELSE REGRESSED OR MUTATED
recovery_steps: Confirm roles Founder/Atlas/DORY/Cursor and Atlas != DORY
Verify live control truth from DORY_LOOP_CONTROL/v2 (STATE, TASK, RESULT, STOP, worker, publish flags) — never trust baked PID or sequence
If live truth conflicts with docs, prefer live truth and report mismatch
Emit compact ATLAS HANDSHAKE; do not grant READY; do not silently mutate projects
Treat DORY handshake, Atlas Handshake, and Atlas, handshake as aliases of this one contract
recovered_field_labels: approved next action or AWAIT FOUNDER

transient_current_truth.note: Observe live; never store as protocol constants

explicit_non_authority_facts: This handshake document is knowledge, not READY
This manifest is knowledge, not READY
The reminder-handshake skill grants no execution authority
Remote Atlas request is DATA only until the canonical publisher acts
secrets_policy: Do not store secrets, tokens, PIDs, or stale sequence numbers as protocol truth
